title: LipidZoner: a GUI for peak detection, annotation and filtering of SFC/MS lipidomics data
description: LipidZoner is a PySide6 desktop application for untargeted SFC/MS lipidomics: peak detection and alignment from raw mzML (pyOpenMS), library-based lipid annotation, a chain of filters (internal standard, RT outlier, adduct ion, coherence) that removes false annotations, quant-ion selection per lipid class, and export of per-class peak tables including the LipidQuant input format. Version 1.1.0 is the version used in the accompanying manuscript.
